summary: Iteration 13 — Segment filter feature regression on Perakende sector. Verified GET /api/dashboard/segments, segment-parameterised filtering on overview + 10 other dashboard endpoints, skills-map-v2 segment narrowing, and Banking (yapikredi) regression. Frontend verified: segment selector shows only for Perakende, country selector remains for Banking, Yetkinlik Haritası no longer shows 'Bankacılık Yetkinlik Kümeleri'. 20/20 pytest + 6/6 Playwright checks pass.

segments_endpoint.GET /api/dashboard/segments?tenant=parak: PASS — returns sector=Perakende and exactly 3 segments [Mağaza / Perakende, Üretim, Merkez Ofis]

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_filtered() applies query['segment']=segment directly on db.employees, which only works because seed_tenant_data writes a 'segment' field on each employee. Any future code path that ingests employees via the Excel/CSV importer (excel_handler.py) must also populate 'segment' or segment filtering will silently drop those rows. Consider deriving segment server-side from DEPT_SEGMENT_MAP at query time (e.g., look up depts for the segment and filter by {'department': {'$in': seg_depts}}) so the feature isn't dependent on a denormalised field.

Banking tenant silently accepts a segment param (Perakende segments like 'Mağaza / Perakende') and returns an empty/banking result instead of 400. For API hygiene, validate the segment against the tenant's SEGMENTS list and return 400 if invalid.

TopBar conditional logic uses sector === 'Perakende' exact match — if a new retail-like sector is added (e.g., 'Hazır Giyim'), the segment filter won't appear even when SEGMENTS is populated. Recommend gating on `segments.length > 0` only (already partially done) and dropping the sector check.

DashboardRoutes uses key={`seg-${segment||'all'}`} on a wrapper <div>, which is a sledgehammer that remounts all child routes on segment change. This works but loses transient component state (open accordions, scroll positions). Consider moving the key onto the matched Route or having pages read segment from a context.
seed_data_creation: None — reused already-seeded 'parakende' (500 employees) and 'yapikredi' tenants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_segment_filter.py is a reusable regression suite for the segment-filter feature. It depends on the parakende tenant already being seeded with the new retail data containing a 'segment' field per employee (this was done in iteration 12). Admin route is /admin/rapor/{slug}/ (public report at /raporlar/{slug} is password-gated). Frontend segment selector uses data-testid='segment-selector'; country selector uses 'country-selector'. The two selectors are mutually exclusive: segment-selector appears iff sector==='Perakende' AND segments.length>0.
